children: may revisit its November 10 low of 4,088 ringgit per barrel, as it has broken a key support at 4,276 ringgit.
A retracement analysis on the uptrend from 4,088 ringgit reveals this support at the 61.8% level. The market failed to hold above this support and resume its uptrend.
The failure may have wiped out the chance of the uptrend to extend. A break above 4,276 ringgit may lead to a gain into the 4,334 to 4,391 ringgit range.

On the daily chart, the big black candlestick during the previous trading session symbolizes a strong bearish sentiment. The downtrend looks intact within a falling channel which suggests a target around 3,864 ringgit.
A realistic target zone is from 4,012 to 4,078 ringgit, formed by the 150% and the 138.2% projection levels of the fall from 4,851 ringgit.
